search.expand_prompt:
Add content to page {page} on channel "{name}" ({site}) following the points below (search_pages id {id}). It averages position {pos} on Google, just short of page one; it needs to fully answer what people searching these terms want to know.

{brief}

How: pull the channel site to $HOME/.shuttle/sites/{site_id} the way the site-audit / ops-backend skills describe (creght pull if it's already there), then edit this page per the points: add sections and an FAQ, and add links to it from the pages listed under internal links. Don't change the page URL, and don't invent facts that aren't on the page or in the project profile (for points that need input from me, ask first or leave them marked).
Push to preview with creght push, set this search_pages row's status to fixing, and tell me where to look on preview. Don't publish: once I've checked and gone live, I'll click "Live, start review" myself.

search.review_desc: Fixed audit issues, published articles, title/description changes and added content are recorded here. 17 days after going live, search clicks for the 14 days before and after are compared (page visits if Search Console isn't linked). Checked daily at 9:00.

versions.no_channels: No social accounts to publish to yet.
versions.flow_hint: Each account's version is reviewed on its own: draft → submit for review → approve → publish or schedule.
versions.empty: No versions yet. Click "Add accounts" and pick where to post; AI can write them all at once.
versions.generating_hint: AI is writing this account's version; it will show up here when done.
versions.add_ai_need_social: Tick the accounts to write for first
versions.add_hint: Pick the accounts for this piece (several is fine). Start blank, or let AI write each one in its platform's style.
versions.publish_hint: These are the approved versions. Check the ones to publish; they go out one by one.
versions.step_draft: Draft: when ready, submit for review; platform rules (length, images) are checked first.
versions.step_pending_review: Pending review: approve it if it looks right, then publish or schedule.
versions.step_approved: Approved: publish now or pick a time to schedule.
versions.step_scheduled: Scheduled: publishes automatically; unschedule to edit.
versions.step_failed: Failed: check the error above, fix it and publish again.
versions.step_rejected: Rejected: fix it and submit for review again.
versions.title: Media versions
versions.desc: One article, a separate version for each account. Editing the article won't overwrite saved versions.
versions.site_independent: This website has its own saved version. Source edits will not overwrite it.
versions.site_from_source: Start from the article and save a separate version for this website.
versions.setup_first: Configure publishing for this website first
versions.new_hint: "Save" creates an empty article to write yourself; "Let AI write it" hands the type and topic to AI.
versions.delete_with_versions: This article already has media versions. Handle them before deleting the article.
versions.published_locked: Published versions keep their original content and metrics. Create a new version for new content.
versions.no_metrics: No data collected for this post yet
versions.rewrite_hint: The assistant edits this version as it is now (including your own edits) and leaves everything you don’t mention alone.
versions.rewrite_ph: For example: a punchier title; lead with the conclusion; drop the third paragraph; add another image
versions.scheduled_in: Scheduled: publishes in {rel} ({at}). Unschedule it (in the schedule button) to edit.
versions.scheduled_due: Scheduled time passed ({at}): it goes out within a few minutes while Annulo is open, or click Publish now.

health.broken: {op} for {platform} account "{name}" isn't working: the platform may have changed its page

company.title: My profile
company.desc: Who you are, who you write for, what and how: AI follows this for topics, articles and posts.

wizard.title: Get started with Creator studio
wizard.next: From the overview, check your website or create content.
wizard.import_hint: The assistant reads your website and fills in your company profile and product catalog. Review and edit them under Company & Products.
wizard.manual: Fill in company and products manually
wizard.connect_hint: Select and connect a Creght or WordPress site. Your import URL will prefill the WordPress address.

brief.brief_cta: What readers should do at the end
brief.gaps_hint: Note missing data, personal experience, examples or screenshots here; they won't be made up when writing.
brief.product_hint: Our product facts come only from Company & products.
brief.products_empty: Add own products in Company & products first.

onboarding.no_ai: No AI model is set up yet, so fill this in yourself. Once a model is set up, AI can read your website and prefill it.
onboarding.site_search: Enter a URL or pick a Creght site
onboarding.no_sites: No Creght sites available. You can enter a website URL directly.
onboarding.preview_hint: If the embedded preview is blocked, use Open website.
onboarding.reparse_site: Analyze this website again with AI (creates a new brief for review)
onboarding.new_site_reparse: A different website is selected. Next will analyze it again; your existing company details stay unchanged until you confirm the new brief.
onboarding.reparse_review: These details are suggestions from the selected website. Review or complete them; your company profile updates when you select Start operations.
onboarding.analysis_running: This website is already being analyzed. Please try again shortly.
onboarding.competitors_hint: One complete URL per line, up to 10. Leave blank for suggestions that you confirm first.
onboarding.positioning_hint: Describe whom you serve and what you offer in one sentence.
onboarding.positioning_example: For example: a manufacturer of customizable office furniture for European and US brands.
onboarding.audience_hint: Pick your main readers, or add your own.
onboarding.business_hint: A few kinds of content; you can change this later.
onboarding.business_example: e.g. building in public, AI tools, side-project lessons
onboarding.cooperation_hint: Only include options you actually offer. Leave blank if unknown.
onboarding.cooperation_example: For example: OEM, ODM, wholesale, private label
onboarding.keywords_hint: Prefer English product terms, separated by commas. You can edit them later.
onboarding.custom_customer: Your own, e.g. designers switching careers
onboarding.extracting: Reading the selected website. Findings will fill empty fields automatically.
onboarding.extracting_wait: Reading the website and filling in company details. The trade brief will open when this finishes.
onboarding.extract_stopped: Website analysis did not finish. Please retry.
onboarding.site_changed: The selected website changed. Please retry.
onboarding.extract_failed: We could not read the website. Go back to analyze it again, or enter the details manually here.
onboarding.extract_hint: Review the brief. Leave anything the site does not confirm blank.
onboarding.required_brief: Fill in what you write about and who for first
onboarding.audience_example: For example: importers, distributors and brand buyers.
onboarding.legacy_note: Your earlier descriptions are kept as additional notes under Company details
onboarding.details_hint: You can change all of this anytime under My profile.
onboarding.to_collect: To be collected from the website
onboarding.audit_summary: Score {score} · {pages} pages · {high} high / {medium} medium / {low} low severity issues
onboarding.need_site: Enter a website URL or select a site in step one before starting.
onboarding.direct_competitors: {n} confirmed competitors; these links will be analyzed directly.
onboarding.confirm_hint: Choose companies to analyze, remove unsuitable suggestions or add your own links. Suggested competitors are not analyzed until confirmed.
onboarding.execution_hint: Results are saved. Resume after closing the page, reuse completed work and retry failed items separately.
onboarding.sites_unavailable: The Creght site list is unavailable. You can still enter a website URL.
onboarding.analysis_hint: Fill company information gaps and check your website as needed.
onboarding.tone_hint: Drafts and posts follow this voice.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.desc: Use the assistant in Annulo on your computer: hand it a task and follow the progress and result here. Annulo must be running on the computer with this project open.
assistant.new_placeholder: What should the assistant do? e.g. which post did best this week
assistant.running_hint: The assistant is working on the computer; this page updates when it's done (no need to keep it open).
assistant.questions: The assistant has a few questions
assistant.questions_hint: Answer in the box below (say which question each answer is for).
assistant.in_shuttle: In Annulo, the assistant is on the right.
assistant.offline: The computer is offline: open Annulo on the computer, turn on "Allow remote calls to this computer" in Settings → Remote access, and open this project.
assistant.need_update: Annulo on the computer is too old, or has another project open: update Annulo and switch to this project on the computer.

article.type_hint: Each type has its own fields and goes to different platforms; you can "Rewrite" it into another type later.
article.t_article_desc: Title + rich text with headings, lists and images in the text.
article.t_post_desc: Title + plain text + a set of images; the first is the cover.
article.desc_ph: What the video is about and who it's for
article.post_ph: Text: short paragraphs; emoji are fine
article.limit_images: Max images: {list}; the first is the cover, drag to reorder
article.category_hint: Bilibili needs a category; enter its name
article.no_video: No video yet: click "Edit" to pick or upload one
article.no_images: No images: a text cover is made from the cover text
article.pub_hint: Pick the accounts to post to (any number). The article goes out as it is; editing it later doesn't change what's already posted.
article.pub_unsupported: This platform doesn't take this type ({type})
article.pub_expired: Login expired: log in again under Accounts
article.pub_too_long: Text is {n} long, over this platform's limit of {max}: it may not post; shorten or rewrite it first
article.pub_sent_before: Posted {when}: publishing again posts it a second time
article.pub_rewrite_hint: Greyed-out accounts don't take this type ({type}); rewrite it into a type they do.
article.records_empty: Not posted to any account yet.
article.legacy_version: An older media version (may differ from the article): delete it to post the article instead
article.delete_published: This article has been posted or scheduled, so it can't be deleted: handle it under Publishing first.
article.rewrite_hint: Rewrites "{title}" into a new article your way; the original stays as it is and the new one appears in the list.
article.rewrite_note_hint: Tweak a preset or write your own.
article.rewrite_ph_article: e.g. Expand into a ~1500-word article with headings
article.rewrite_ph_post: e.g. Short, under 200 words, open with a hook
article.rewrite_ph_video: e.g. Title and description for a 1-minute talking-head video
article.presets_hint: Instructions you use often. Click one to fill in both the type and the instructions.
article.presets_empty: No presets yet: pick a type and write the instructions below, then click "Save as preset".
article.rewriting_desc: The result is saved as a new article under "Rewritten articles" below and in the list; click "View" to follow along.
